_about: Acetone (1) + chloroform (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa from Gao et al. (2018), Table A1. Rows as printed: T in K, liquid and vapour mole fractions of acetone.

source.citation: Q. Gao, Z. Zhao, P. Jia, X. Zhang, Effect of Ionic Liquids on the Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Behavior of Acetone-Chloroform, Applied Sciences 8 (2018) 1519
source.access: Open access, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0).

notes: Modified Othmer still, gas chromatography (TCD). Standard uncertainties stated in the caption: u(T) = 0.1 K, u(x1) = u(y1) = 0.002. Purities above 99.5 % (mass). Only 9 points, no pure-component temperatures listed, no consistency test reported; the authors state agreement with Kojima et al. (1991). Read twice from the article page, both reads identical.
